export interface Contact { name: string, email: string, message: string }
export type ContactErrors = Partial<Record<keyof Contact, string>>

export function checkContact(input: Contact): ContactErrors {
  const errors: ContactErrors = {}
  const email = input.email.trim()

  if (input.name.trim() === '')
    errors.name = 'Name is required.'

  if (email === '')
    errors.email = 'Email is required.'
  else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email))
    errors.email = 'Enter a valid email address.'

  if (input.message.trim().length < 20)
    errors.message = 'Message must be at least 20 characters.'

  return errors
}

cat > src/routes/contact.kay <<'E'
--- server
import { s } from 'kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import ContactForm from '../components/contact-form.kay'

const message = s.Object({
  name: s.String({ maxLength: 200 }),
  email: s.String({ maxLength: 200 }),
  message: s.String({ maxLength: 5000 }),
})

export const contact = action(message, (input, ctx) => {
  const errors = checkContact(input)

  if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0)
    return ctx.fail(422, { errors })

  return { name: input.name.trim() }
})
---
head
  title Contact
h1 Contact
ContactForm

cat > src/components/contact-form.kay <<'E'
---
import { contact } from '../routes/contact.kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import type { ContactErrors } from '../contact'

const errors = signal<ContactErrors>(contact.failed()?.data?.errors ?? {})
const thanked = signal(contact.succeeded()?.data.name ?? '')

async function submit(event: SubmitEvent) {
  event.preventDefault()
  const form = event.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement
  const fields = new FormData(form)
  const found = checkContact({
    name: String(fields.get('name')),
    email: String(fields.get('email')),
    message: String(fields.get('message')),
  })

  errors.set(found)
  thanked.set('')

  if (Object.keys(found).length === 0) {
    thanked.set((await contact(fields, { refresh: false })).name)
    form.reset()
  }
}
---
if thanked()
  p Thanks, {thanked()}! Your message has been sent.
form(action={contact} novalidate onSubmit={submit})
  label(for="name") Name
  input#name(name="name" type="text")
  if errors().name
    p.error {errors().name}
  label(for="email") Email
  input#email(name="email" type="email")
  if errors().email
    p.error {errors().email}
  label(for="message") Message
  textarea#message(name="message")
  if errors().message
    p.error {errors().message}
  button(type="submit") Send
